# Editorial-Only Blocks

Singular Alerts can mark an alert block as **Editorial Only** so it appears in the block editor but does not render on the frontend.

## When to Use Editorial-Only Mode

* Author notes and reminders ("Do not edit this section — legal review required").
* Editor-to-editor instructions during content review.
* Workflow markers visible only to users with block editor access.
* Draft-stage callouts you do not want visitors to see.

## Enabling Editorial-Only Mode

1. Select an alert block in the editor.
2. Open the block **Settings** sidebar panel.
3. Enable **Editorial Only** (or **Block Editorial Only**).

The alert remains fully visible and editable in the block editor. On the frontend, the block outputs nothing — no HTML, no styles, no scripts.

## Shortcodes

Editorial-only mode is a block editor feature. Shortcodes always render on the frontend when used in content areas that process shortcodes.
